name: The Canticlysm
aliases: The Golden Age of the Song
desc:
The Canticlysm was an era of considerable social upheaval and innovation that ended with the arrival of [the Tides](event:the_tides). It is the last era of the Old World, considered by many to be the Golden Age of the Song and of humanity. It is revealed in several Books that the reason the Canticlysm ended was because of misuse or overuse of the song and, therefore, the Tides were a punishment by the gods for this. During this period of time, the Song was used for quite literally everything, such as a Flamecharm users utilizing their abilities to cook food. It was also the time when the Song and Humanity was at it's most powerful, which is why it is referred to as "The Golden Age of the Song".

The Four Basic Attunements, Flamecharm, Frostdraw, Galebreathe and Thundercall were discovered and developed during the Canticlysm; the peak of understanding The Song, and also the eventual downfall of the Old World. The first Galebreathers of the Canticlysm wield the [Curved Blade of Winds](weapon:curved_blade_of_winds); dual scimitars attuned to the Winds.
